page.layout: One printed page, title page with a central engraving. Top: a large title in italic and capitals, with a short line above. Centre: a woodcut or engraving. Below the engraving: a line of capitals and a smaller line beneath. No margin notes.
page.notes: The scan is heavily damaged and shows strong show-through from the reverse side: many lines are mirrored or upside down and are not counted as printed text here. The engraving in the centre is not transcribed. Large parts of the title lines are unreadable; the lines given are the best readings and carry [?] where doubtful. The top line and the lines under the engraving are the least certain.
